result.text:
The generated AGENTS.md and Harness skill now state the five allowed test forms and the stable-case bug policy for both app and library projects. The focused tests and the three existing unit tests that read this guidance all pass. Nothing is committed, and I didn't run the full `bun run check`, typecheck, root audit, E2E, or any screenshots.

**What changed**

- `src/templates/projects-sessions/projectGuidance.ts`
  - A new **Standard Test Forms** section lists the five forms: pages, components, helpers, classes, and APIs. It also says interaction, accessibility, and console assertions stay inside those cases, other functions and classes map by behavior, and projects without UI have no page or component cases. It also says screenshot baselines are never auto-accepted, and that missing coverage fails explicitly.
  - A new **Stable-Case Bug Policy** section says bugs strengthen existing cases, case counts stay fixed unless the contract explicitly changes a capability, and case titles and identities stay stable.
  - Each document gets one operating rule pointing to these sections.
  - Three generic add-a-test lines were reworded. "Keep exhaustive boundary cases in tests" is now "a helper's unit cases are exactly its authored examples". "Reproduce with a failing test" is now "its strengthened standardized case". "Include the guard" is now "a strengthened standardized case".
  - Non-test controls are unchanged.
- `test/project-template.test.ts`: a new `expectGeneratedGuidance` helper runs the existing rename check and a new forms check. Both existing test titles and counts are unchanged.
- `test/regression-loops.test.ts`: the existing per-kind guidance case gained stable-case assertions, plus negative checks for the removed wording.

**Interpretation choices**

- "Five forms" is read as pages, components, helpers, classes, and APIs, with pages and components counted separately.
- "Generic add-a-test advice" is read as the three lines above. The shared `bugRepairPolicy()` bullets stay verbatim.

**Verification**

- Red, against the unchanged generator: `bun src/index.ts resources run --priority agent-test --cpus 1 --memory-mib 2048 -- sh -c 'vitest run test/project-template.test.ts test/regression-loops.test.ts'`. Four tests failed on the new missing-text assertions, and nine passed.
- Green, final revision: the same two files, 13 of 13 pass, with fresh evidence recorded to `/tmp/harness-evidence-6d30ed22-final`.
- Consumers: `vitest run test/browser-console-errors.test.ts test/clean-code-integrity.test.ts test/game-project.test.ts`, 17 of 17 pass.
- `prettier --check` on the four owned files passes. I formatted one test file, and the change only wrapped a line.
- `eslint` on the four owned files passes. It flagged a 56-line test body, which I fixed with the helper.
- `harness units check`: "Units registry is valid: 1787 units."
- Measurements for `template.project-guidance` at the working tree, which is uncommitted: source went from 14,370 bytes and 107 lines at HEAD to 16,965 bytes and 136 lines. The module observations were about 0.02 to 0.09 ms with whole-process peak RSS about 224 to 259 MB. The `layout-catalog-behavior` case took 3.2 ms with whole-worker RSS 245 MB. The RSS figures are not isolated unit memory. The workload label predates this change and was kept for identity.

**Not run**

- Full `bun run check`, typecheck, and root audit. The 220-line limit was checked by counting lines instead.
- E2E tests. `test/loop.e2e.test.ts` still asserts the unchanged loop-create line.
- `harness loop record` red and green. Those need commits, and I did not create a loop because loop metadata sits outside the allowed files.

**Remaining gaps**

1. `function.bug-repair-policy` (`src/utils/development-tooling/bugRepairPolicy.ts`) is outside my allowed files. It is shared with desktop run context, the loop guide, and the SDK export, and it still says "extend reusable standardized coverage" and "commit the failing test". The new section clarifies the fixed-count rule.
2. `template.development-tooling-atomic-guidance` (`src/templates/development-tooling/atomicGuidance.ts`) still says "focused interaction tests". That line also lands in generated AGENTS.md.
3. The unit manifest `specification/units/template.project-guidance.json` doesn't yet mention the five forms in its responsibility or skill-output description.
4. The unit's frozen size budget needs reconciliation at full verification. The ledger baseline is 4,311 bytes, which is already below HEAD's 14,370.
5. `packages/*/AGENTS.md`, the packaged `.codex/skills/harness/SKILL.md` copies, and `README.md` still carry the older bug-policy wording. I did not regenerate them.
6. Nothing enforces the five-form matrix yet. The guidance states the rule, and the existing `units check` only enforces helper examples.
7. The template kind has no explorer page, so the unit is linked by source. I didn't start or verify the shared preview.

Activity `c98d4c5f-0f1b-48f9-8288-7b5ec705f8f0` is registered and finished.

result.text:
The scaffold guidance now states one of five test shapes for every scaffold kind, and the focused guide tests pass. The change is uncommitted in this worktree. Two gaps sit in files outside my allowed list, so they need their owners.

## Changed files (unit `guide.scaffolds`, direct edits)

- **`src/guides/development-tooling/scaffolds.ts`**: adds a test-shape table. An exhaustive `Record<PieceKind, …>` maps all 36 scaffold kinds, so a new kind won't type-check until it has a shape. The catalog gets the five shapes and the class/function rule, and each kind gets a `Test shape:` line. Exports are unchanged.
- **`test/guides.test.ts`**: no new `test(` declarations. I added one coverage assertion to the existing every-kind test, and assertions to the existing scaffold test, which is now wrapped in `measureWorkload('guide.scaffolds', 'scaffold-test-shape-guidance', …)`.
- **`src/guides/scaffolds.ts`**: unchanged (re-export shim).

Dependencies checked, not edited: `template.scaffold-types` (`PieceKind`, scaffold details), `function.catalog` (`harnessNamingRules`), and consumer `guide.guide`.

## Mapping decisions to check

- I read "pages and components" as two shapes, so the five are page screenshot, component screenshot, helper examples, class method-state cases and API JSON match.
- Page: `view`, `e2e`, and `game-view` (my call). Component: `component`, `partial`, `layout`. Helper: `helper`. API: `api`. Class: the 15 class scaffolds. `resource` maps per generated piece. `feature` has no test shape. The other 11 kinds map by behavior.

## Verification (focused only)

- `bun x vitest run test/guides.test.ts`: 7/7 pass.
- Same run with `test/readable-unit-contracts.test.ts`: 9/9 pass.
- Red check: the final test file against committed `scaffolds.ts` fails exactly the two changed tests. My file was restored byte-identical.
- ESLint on the three files: clean. My first version had a complexity error (14 > 10) in the test callback, which I fixed.
- Prettier on the three files: clean.
- Focused `tsc` (temporary tsconfig in `/tmp`, the three files as roots): exit 0.
- `bun run dev -- units check`: valid, 1787 units, 161 uncertain references (unchanged).
- `bun run dev -- audit src/guides`: exit 1 with 14 `harness-root-file-structure` findings, all on root-level guide files. None are on changed content, and there are no size, function or nesting findings.
- Workload recorded in `/tmp/harness-guides-evidence/run-*`: `scaffold-test-shape-guidance` took 0.343 ms, with whole-worker RSS of 91,078,656 bytes. That is not isolated unit memory.
- Source measurements, `budget measure guide.scaffolds`: committed 3,600 bytes, 95 lines, complexity 11, 3 deps. Working tree 7,526 bytes, 187 lines, complexity 13, 3 deps.

Not run: `bun run check`, E2E, browser and screenshot checks (no UI changed), and any broad check.

## Gaps and blockers

1. **Shadowed guides** (`src/guides/development-tooling/guide.ts`, not in my allowed files). Hand-written `controller` (:55), `service` (:75), `decorator` (:88), `component` (:101) and `feature` (:122) come before `...scaffoldGuides()` (:167), and `findGuide` takes the first match. So `harness info component` still says "Add a component test or page smoke test." The catalog, `harness info scaffolds`, shows the mapping for every kind.
2. **Template `contains` text** (`src/templates/development-tooling/scaffoldTypes.ts`, not mine). It still says "smoke test" for view, layout, component and partial, and "Single starting assertion." for `test`.
3. **Frozen budget** (`specification/budgets/ledger.ndjson`, not mine). The `guide.scaffolds` baseline (1,704 bytes, complexity 5, 2 deps, 2026-10-11) was already behind `HEAD`. This change moves it to 7,526 / 13 / 3. It needs a reviewed budget record.
4. **Commit-tree measurements and the loop record** need a commit. I did not create a `harness loop`, because its metadata lives in tracked `specification/loops/`, outside my allowed files.
5. **Not verified**: the explorer page and History for `guide.scaffolds`, since I opened no preview.

## Other notes

- `harness info helper` prints the group rules twice, because `scaffoldGuide` and the final map in `guide.ts` both add them. This predates my change, and I left it.
- I ran `bun install --frozen-lockfile` because `node_modules` was missing. The lockfile is unchanged, and `node_modules` is gitignored.
- Activity `a614b82a-e4f2-4473-b08b-edb6b3c048b4` is registered and finished.
